arxiv-2111-14709.title: Linguistic Knowledge in Data Augmentation for Natural Language Processing: An Example on Chinese Question Matching
arxiv-2111-14709.creator: Zhengxiang Wang
arxiv-2111-14709.description: Abstract To investigate the role of linguistic knowledge in data augmentation (DA) for Natural Language Processing (NLP), we designed two adapted DA programs and applied them to LCQMC (a Large-scale Chinese Question Matching Corpus) for a binary Chinese question matching classification task.

arxiv-2211-05339.title: Writing summary for the state-of-the-art methods for big data clustering in distributed environment Thanks: Identify applicable funding agency here. If none, delete this.
arxiv-2211-05339.creator: Dipesh Gyawali
arxiv-2211-05339.description: Abstract Big Data processing systems handle huge unstructured and structured data to store, process, and analyze through cluster analysis which helps in identifying unseen patterns to find the relationships between them. Clustering analysis over the shared machines in big data technologies helps in deriving the relations and making decisions using data in context.

arxiv-2308-11629.title: Autonomous Vehicles as a Sensor: Simulating Data Collection Process
arxiv-2308-11629.creator: Yunfei Zhang, Mario Ilic, Klaus Bogenberger
arxiv-2308-11629.description: Abstract Urban traffic state estimation is pivotal in furnishing precise and reliable insights into traffic flow characteristics, thereby enabling efficient traffic management. Traditional traffic estimation methodologies have predominantly hinged on labor-intensive and costly techniques such as loop detectors and floating car data.

arxiv-2407-06618.title: Modular Family Symmetry in Fluxed GUTs
arxiv-2407-06618.creator: Vasileios Basiouris, Miguel Crispim Romão, Stephen F. King, George K. Leontaris
arxiv-2407-06618.description: Abstract We discuss modular family symmetry in effective theories based on generic properties of bottom-up local F-theory inspired GUTs broken by fluxes, which we refer to as Fluxed GUTs. We argue that the Yukawa couplings will depend on the complex structure moduli of the matter curves in such a way that they can be modular forms associated with these symmetries.

arxiv-2602-16573.title: MoDE-Boost: Boosting Shared Mobility Demand with Edge-Ready Prediction Models A preliminary version of this paper appears in 23
arxiv-2602-16573.creator: Antonios Tziorvas, George S. Theodoropoulos, Yannis Theodoridis
arxiv-2602-16573.description: Abstract Urban demand forecasting plays a critical role in optimizing routing, dispatching, and congestion management within Intelligent Transportation Systems. By leveraging data fusion and analytics techniques, traffic demand forecasting serves as a key intermediate measure for identifying emerging spatial and temporal demand patterns.

pmc-11444197.title: Honey as a Sugar Substitute in Gluten-Free Bread Production
pmc-11444197.creator: Michela Cannas, Costantino Fadda, Pietro Paolo Urgeghe, Antonio Piga, Paola Conte
pmc-11444197.description: In recent years, there has been a significant focus on enhancing the overall quality of gluten-free breads by incorporating natural and healthy compounds to meet consumer expectations regarding texture, flavor, and nutritional value. Considering the high glycemic index associated with gluten-free products, the use of honey, renowned for its numerous health benefits, may serve as an optimal alternative to sucrose.

pmc-12638069.title: Short-Term Morbidity and Mortality in Patients Undergoing Radical Cystectomy at a Tertiary Care Center: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-12638069.creator: Saundarya Kumar Verma, Saleem Wani, Abdul Rouf Khawaja, Sajad A Malik, Sajjad A Para, Arif Hamid, Saqib Mehdi, Mudasir Ahmad Tantray, Tufeel Ahmad Khan
pmc-12638069.description: Background: Radical cystectomy (RC) is the standard treatment for muscle-invasive bladder cancer (MIBC) but is associated with significant perioperative morbidity and mortality. This study evaluates short-term (90-day) morbidity and mortality outcomes following RC at Sher-I-Kashmir Institute of Medical Sciences (SKIMS), Srinagar, to identify complications and risk factors.

pmc-13045080.title: Loneliness in older adults: an assessment on social network usage, social support, and active aging
pmc-13045080.creator: Mükerrem Kabataş Yıldız, Ayşe Çal
pmc-13045080.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to examine the relationship between social network usage, active aging, perceived social support, and loneliness among community-dwelling older adults aged 60 years and above who live in a city center in Türkiye and use social networks.MethodsThe data for this descriptive study were collected between November 2022 and May 2023.

pmc-13321700.title: Perceived quality of care of medical abortions in the public health system in Catalonia (Spain)
pmc-13321700.creator: Encarnación López-Gimeno, Gemma Falguera Puig, Cristina Martínez Bueno, Rosa García-Sierra, Ma Mercedes Vicente-Hernández, Josep Grau Galtés, Rosa M Cabedo-Ferreiro
pmc-13321700.description: BackgroundIn Spain, induced abortions are covered by the public health system. In the region of Catalonia, under the scope of Primary Care, the Sexual and Reproductive Health Care Units (ASSIR) attend to women who choose to have a medical abortion (MA) up to 9.6 weeks of gestation.

pmc-13474394.title: Cerebrolysin as an adjunct to speech-language therapy in post-stroke Wernicke’s aphasia: a case report
pmc-13474394.creator: Marina Romano
pmc-13474394.description: Post-stroke aphasia is a debilitating condition affecting approximately one-third of stroke survivors, profoundly impairing communication, social participation, and quality of life. While speech-language therapy (SLT) remains the standard of care, pharmacological agents such as Cerebrolysin may enhance recovery through neuroprotection and neuroplasticity.

pmc-13548369.title: Tris(3,5-di­aza-1-azonia-7-phosphaadamant-7-yl)(1,3,5-tri­aza-7-phospha-adamantane)silver(I) dicarbonate
pmc-13548369.creator: Sizwe J. Zamisa, Adesola A. Adeleke, Olatunde S. Olatunji, Bernard Omondi
pmc-13548369.description: In the title salt, the silver(I) ion is coordinated by both neutral 1,3,5-tri­aza-7-phosphaadamantane (PTA) and protonated PTAH+ ligands. Structure description The phosphine ligand 1,3,5-tri­aza-7-phosphaadamantane (C6H12N3P; PTA) has garnered growing inter­est because of its water solubility and distinctive coordination properties arising from a soft phospho­rus donor and three nitro­gen atoms (Krogstad et al., 2007 ▸).

pmc-13608276.title: Building a Rural, Coalition-Based Approach to Youth Substance Use Prevention: The Drug Free Dickson Coalition Model
pmc-13608276.creator: Karrie R. Thompson
pmc-13608276.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Youth substance use remains a critical public health issue in the United States, with rural communities experiencing disproportionate risk because of limited access to prevention resources and persistent barriers related to behavioral and mental health. Rural youth are often exposed to elevated risk factors, including geographic isolation, reduced availability of extracurricular and prosocial activities, transportation limitations, and fewer specialized prevention and treatment services.

pmc-13617496.title: Interplay between Skin Sympathetic Nerve Activity and Gut Microbiota, the Neurocardiac Axis in Acute Coronary Syndrome
pmc-13617496.creator: Wei-Chung Tsai, Po Peng, Pei-Syuan Jhou, Yi-Chun Tsai, Wei-Wen Hung, Tien-Chi Huang, Li-Fang Chou, Tsung-Hsien Lin, Chien-Hung Lee, Bin-Nan Wu, Shien-Fong Lin, Wei-Chun Hung
pmc-13617496.description: Our previous study demonstrated increased skin sympathetic nerve activity (SKNA) in acute coronary syndrome (ACS) patients and its correlation with ventricular arrhythmias. In the current study, we explored specific gut microbial profiles and their relationships with SKNA in ACS patients. Fifteen ACS patients and age- and sex-matched controls were included in this cross-sectional study.
